Benefits that Support You
Feel Supported at Work
As an independent practice founded and led by practicing veterinary oncologists, ACCC offers a collaborative, team-first environment where every voice is valued. Direct access to leadership means quick decisions and the flexibility to do what’s best for our patients and team.
Independently owned and managed by veterinary oncologists
Collaborative culture and direct access to leadership
Flat organizational structure for quick, responsive decisions
Seven locations across Central and South Florida
Over 100 team members—including 13 oncology specialists
Grow Your Career
We believe delivering exceptional specialty care starts with taking care of the people who provide it. At ACCC, you will find a collaborative, approachable environment designed to protect your personal time, eliminate burnout, and ensure you feel genuinely heard and supported every single day.
Predictable, Restful Downtime:
Enjoy flexible, customized schedules with no on-call or overnight responsibilities for doctors, plus guaranteed closures on federal holidays.
Accessible, Responsive Leadership:
Work within a flat organizational structure where leadership is approachable, decisions happen quickly, and your voice directly shapes our workflow.
A Truly Supportive Team:
Collaborate alongside peers and specialists who value mutual respect, shared problem-solving, and a positive day-to-day work environment.
Find Your Balance
Your professional trajectory matters as much as the exceptional care you deliver. We actively invest in your future from day one, providing structured mentorship, consistent feedback, and clear pathways to help you expand your clinical expertise, take on new challenges, and reach your full potential.
Dedicated Continuing Education:
Expand your veterinary oncology skills with robust financial and time-off support for CE, conferences, and certifications.
Continuous Feedback & Structured Reviews:
Stay aligned on your goals with regular monthly check-ins and formal annual performance and compensation reviews.
Clear Pathways for Advancement:
Unlock promotion opportunities and internal leadership roles as our practice network continues to expand across Florida.
High-Impact Stretch Assignments:
Gain hands-on exposure to leadership, specialized clinical protocols, and cross-functional initiatives to accelerate your career growth.
Benefits that support you
Full-Spectrum Health & Security:
Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and life insurance coverage to keep you and your family protected.
Long-Term Wealth Building:
Plan for tomorrow with a 401(k) retirement savings program.
Generous Time to Recharge:
Paid time off (PTO), dedicated sick leave, and paid company holidays to ensure you rest and reset.
Dedicated CE & Travel Stipends:
Funded continuing education allowances and travel support to advance your specialty knowledge.
Everyday Perks & Wellness:
Generous employee pet care discounts, confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) wellness resources, and an annual uniform allowance.
Competitive Opportunities:
Signing bonuses available for qualifying specialty and key roles.

Veterinary Oncology Jobs in Florida
Animal Cancer Care Clinic (ACCC) is Florida’s largest veterinary oncology practice, with seven locations across Fort Lauderdale, Orlando, Miami, Melbourne, Stuart, West Palm Beach, and Deerfield Beach. We are actively hiring veterinary oncologists, surgeons, experienced vet techs, and support staff who want to thrive in a vet-owned practice that values flexibility, excellence, and work-life balance. Explore our open positions below.

Onboarding Options:
Our
“Consult to Convert Program”
allows you to customize a flexible consulting schedule (part or full time; daily rate; paid travel expenses) while evaluating your decision to join ACCC. Low risk; very high reward.
Location:
Florida has no state income tax and over 200 days of sunshine!
Welcome! I am glad you have arrived here on this page to learn about us and evaluate a prospective “match” for your time and talent.
As you review this information, I encourage you to think about both the factors contributing to your decision to
take
a new job, as well as those that cause you to want to
stay and thrive
in that job – the compatibility, inspiration, fulfillment, and opportunities you hope to experience in your new job on a day-to-day basis, and over the course of your career.
From one Oncology Specialist to another, I understand that making job and career decisions in our industry is exciting and intense. If the information on this page and our general website appeals to you, then I very much want to speak to you. Please call or email me directly or complete the form above. I wish you the very best, no matter where your decisions lead.
Dr. Stephanie Correa, DVM, DACVIM (Oncology)
Founder and President, Animal Cancer Care Clinic
954-527-3111
“Because we are vet-owned and operated, our management knows how we work and provides the tools and support we need to keep focused on what we should be. From our specialized staff and equipment to the clinics themselves – everything is customized for us. We are truly centered around providing the best cancer care environment for our clients and patients and if we ever get even slightly distracted from that, our leadership brings us right back to it.”
Dr. Sones
Veterinary Oncologist Specialist
“I think we have the benefits of both worlds. We have staff all over Florida, but on a day-to-day basis we work in small groups. Having multiple locations allows for convenience and accessibility for clients and many of us nurses enjoy working in different locations. We get to see different faces and because we are not overly regimented, we see variations in doctors’ styles. This keeps things from becoming too routine.”
Rachel Charrette
Veterinary Technician
“The benefits of working in a vet-owned hospital are significant. Dr. Correa is involved in the day-to-day operations of the organization. She understands the difficulties at hand because she is on the floor of the hospital dealing with them alongside her team. I’m not sure that size has anything to do with it. This is NOT your typical workplace, and I am told from my colleagues who have been here much longer than me, that the practice has been the same since the beginning. We have always held ourselves to a higher standard in patient care, client care, and respect for one another. So, I don’t think what I love about ACCC has to do with its size.”
Jessica Dilbeck
Training Coordinator
